title: Safe saves
summary: SaveSlots autoload (--save=<slot>, headless runs use a throwaway slot, atomic JSON + backup) and a Settings autoload skeleton that never writes the player's file in tests, with input-action labels
claude_md: - Saves go through `SaveSlots` (user://saves/<slot>/); tests and tools pass `--save=<slot>` and never touch the player's saves or settings. UI key names come from `Settings.get_action_label()`.
